title: Vushtrri Stone Bridge
note: The Vushtrri Stone Bridge spans a dry meadow in nine varied pointed masonry arches. A shallow deck hump and bent centerline follow the crossing, with warm voussoir rings, a rounded stone belt, irregular upright parapet blocks and graded stone approaches. The fixed 510 m datum comes from standard Terrarium. Near each mapped path end the deck matches sampled ground, and the masonry feet extend below that surface. The site uses the ordinary viewer terrain without a terrain or water cutout.
